title: Efficient targeting of arbitrary excited states with quantum inverse power iteration through filtering polynomials
summary: In this work, we introduce a quantum inverse power iteration (QIPI) algorithm based on the quantum singular value transformation (QSVT) to target arbitrary excited states. Given an energy shift $ω$, QIPI prepares the target excited state by iteratively applying an approximation of the shifted inverse Hamiltonian $(H-ωI)^{-1}$ to a trial state.
